event_trace_policy: Sanitized observable app-server events; encrypted/non-summary reasoning, system/developer, and authentication fields are removed before persistence.
observable_reasoning_policy: Raw app-server JSONL retains API-exposed summaries and tool events only; hidden chain-of-thought is not requested or available.

usage_field_semantics.cache_write_input_tokens: Codex app-server TokenUsageBreakdown schema default 0 is applied when cacheWriteInputTokens is omitted

usage_measurement: exact deduplicated app-server rawResponse/completed usage, including explicitly classified context-compaction responses
